Moiraine manipulates Rand's path by giving him the Dragon banner and arranging his position as second; Rand resents this manipulation but feels unable to escape it
Childhood friends; Rand came on the journey to help Mat find the dagger; Mat is now terrified of Rand because he can channel and distances himself
Childhood friends; Perrin is troubled by Rand's ability to channel but more thoughtful and less openly fearful than Mat; advises Rand
Travel companions; Loial shows no fear of Rand and camps with him
Hurin gladly makes his bed near Rand and treats him with respect, showing no fear
Ba'alzamon summoned Fain and transformed him to track Rand and the others; Fain was Fain's master but Fain now believes himself freed from that control
Fain obsessively tracks Rand; wants to lure Rand to Toman Head and kill him; believes Rand will follow him
Moiraine was present when Agelmar gave Ingtar orders; they cooperated to arrange Rand's position as second
Both told Rand he's the Dragon Reborn; working together to manipulate his path
Ingtar commands Uno to organize scouts; Uno would normally be second in command but Rand has been placed above him
Travel together and share concerns about Rand; both are Rand's childhood friends
